title: BMM150
text: Measure magnetic field from BMM150 sensor, 2 outputs, {I2C address} sets I2C address of BMM150 sensor; {I2C module} sets the module for communication, {Status} sets the output port for obtaining magnetic field, {Preset value}, {Data type} sets the output data type for values from BMM150 sensor and {Sample time} sets the time interval to read data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Magnetic Field
ports.summary: Magnetic field strength measured by a BMM150 sensor row vector

params.name: Status
params.values: Set output port for obtaining magnetic field status on (default) | off

params.name: Preset value
params.values: Preset value for the operating condition of BMM150 sensor Low power (default) | Regular | Enhanced | High accuracy

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type for values from BMM150 sensor single (default) | double

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval to read data -1 (default) | positive integer
